versions.content: Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTrigger Transmit_<CGI> Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTriggerTransmit_<CGI> Syntax Std_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTriggerTransmit_<CGI> ( CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId, PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x0106 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant Parameters (in) ComUserCbkHandleId Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API Parameters (inout) PduInfoPtr Contains a pointer to a buffer (SduDataPtr) to where the SDU data shall be copied, and the available buffer size in SduLengh. On return, the service will indicate the length of the copied SDU data in SduLength. Parameters (out) None ▽ 1001 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 △ Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : SDU has been copied and SduLength indicates the number of copied bytes. E_NOT_OK : No SDU data has been copied. PduInfoPtr shall not be used since it may contain a NULL pointer or point to invalid data. Description Rte_Rips_NotifyTriggerTransmit notifies the RTE Implementation Plug-In that the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation has triggered a copy of the available data into the SduDataPtr. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the Ld Com_IF Rte_LdComCbkTriggerTransmit callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_00001] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
